title: Three screens give three different answers to "are there open credits?" — the payment dialog names 50 ILS of credits no screen can show
evidence: out/finance/60-pay-card-open.png + text-pay-card-open.txt: the execution dialog for חוות השדה 299 ILS shows a red block reading 'אושר באישור חריג ללא קיזוז הזיכוי. הזיכויים הפתוחים בסך ‏50.00 ‏₪ לא קוזזו אוטומטית.' and, 15px below it, a grey block reading 'זיכויים זמינים לקיזוז / אין זיכויים פתוחים לספק זה', plus 'קיזוז זיכויים ‏0.00 ‏₪'. out/finance/10-credits-all.png (/credits?status=all): exactly ONE credit exists in the whole tenant — #4, אריזות הדרום, 150 ILS, already offset — and the header reads 'סה״כ זיכויים פתוחים: —'. out/finance/10-acct-dashboard.png: KPI 'זיכויים פתוחים 0'. out/finance/text-exceptions.txt line 39: an OPEN exception 'זיכוי שלא קוזז — זיכוי פתוח שטרם קוזז — דגי הים התיכון'.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /pay → click the חוות השדה 299 ₪ card → read the red block and the grey block below it → open /credits?status=all in the same session → open /exceptions.
expected: One trustworthy picture (§12). If 50 ILS of credits are open for חוות השדה, /credits and the dashboard must show them; if none are open, the execution dialog must not claim they exist and were skipped.
actual: /pay says 50 ILS of open credits exist and were not offset; the same dialog says the supplier has none; /credits (filter 'הכל') lists one credit in the entire tenant and none open; the dashboard says 0; /exceptions says an un-offset open credit exists for a third supplier. The accountant cannot find, verify or claim the 50 ILS.

title: A credit whose status says it was offset never reduces the invoice balance — the supplier card's own ledger nets to zero while its headline says 150 ILS is still owed
evidence: out/finance/text-inv-3377.txt (/invoices/f4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014): 'סה״כ חשבונית ‏900.00 ‏₪ · שולם ‏750.00 ‏₪ · זוכה ‏0.00 ‏₪ · יתרה לתשלום ‏150.00 ‏₪', and the invoice's own note line 'קוזז זיכוי 150 ₪ מהיתרה'. out/finance/20-finsup-0013.png + text-finsup-0013.txt: headline 'יתרה פתוחה ‏150 ‏₪' while 'פעילות פיננסית אחרונה' on the same card lists תשלום #6 −750, זיכוי #4 −150, חשבונית 3377 +900 — which nets to 0. out/finance/10-credits-all.png: credit #4, 150 ILS, invoice 3377, status 'קוזז בתשלום' (src/lib/status.ts:230 comments that offset is a final success state). Code: supabase/migrations/0218 p0_invoice_balance_rows_by_currency derives credited_amount only from payment_allocations rows carrying credit_id, so a credit marked offset with no such allocation contributes nothing.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /credits?status=all (credit #4 shows 'קוזז בתשלום') → /invoices?q=3377 → open the row → read 'זוכה' and 'יתרה לתשלום' → open /finance/suppliers/aa000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013 and compare the headline with the activity list below it.
expected: A credit in a final 'offset' state either reduces the invoice balance (זוכה 150, יתרה 0) or is not shown as offset. The supplier card's headline balance must equal its own activity ledger.
actual: The credit is reported as consumed on /credits, contributes 0.00 to the invoice, and 150 ILS stays open on the invoice, on the supplier card and in the dashboard total. 150 of the accountant's entire reported open payables of 790 ILS (19%) is money already settled.

title: Both items in the execution queue target invoices whose balance is already zero, and the dialog never shows the invoice balance
evidence: out/finance/text-pay-card-open.txt: pending card חוות השדה 299 ILS → 'חשבוניות QA-R3-1112376'; out/finance/text-inv-qar3.txt shows that invoice at 'שולם ‏562.00 ‏₪ · יתרה לתשלום ‏0.00 ‏₪ · שולמה' (paid by #12 262 + #13 300). out/finance/text-pay-card2.txt: pending card נקי וזוהר 300 ILS → 'חשבוניות 2088'; out/finance/text-invoices.txt shows 2088 at 1,062 ILS, payment status 'שולמה', balance '—'. out/finance/text-exceptions.txt line 35: an OPEN high-severity exception 'חשד לתשלום כפול — חשד לדרישת תשלום כפולה — #12 · נקי וזוהר'. Neither dialog shows the target invoice's current balance — only 'סכום מאושר / קיזוז זיכויים / סכום להעברה בפועל'.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /pay → open each of the 2 cards under 'העברות ממתינות לביצוע' → note the invoice number → open that invoice from /invoices and read 'יתרה לתשלום'.
expected: An approved request whose invoice has since been settled is marked as such in the queue (or withdrawn), and the execution dialog shows the invoice's live balance next to the amount to be paid. §12: the screen must not present a payment that would over-pay as ready to go.
actual: 2 of 2 queued transfers would pay invoices that owe nothing; the dialog shows no balance and no warning; the product has already opened a high-severity duplicate-payment exception for one of them and the /pay screen does not mention it. I did NOT press 'ההעברה בוצעה' — whether the server refuses is untested and belongs to the money-actions agent.

title: A phantom '$ 0' balance row on a supplier with no dollar activity, directly above the banner stating the product shows — and not zero
evidence: out/finance/20-finsup-0013.png (read with the Read tool): 'יתרה פתוחה' renders two lines, '150 ₪' and '$ 0'. The card lists no USD invoice, payment, credit, payment request or bank line anywhere (חשבוניות זמינות לתפקיד: 3377 only, ILS; תשלומים: #6 ILS; זיכויים: #4 ILS). The banner immediately beneath states the product's own policy: 'אין במערכת מועדי פירעון שמאפשרים לחשב חשיפה שהגיעה למועד; לכן מוצג — ולא אפס.'
repro: Sign in as accountant → /finance/suppliers/aa000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013 → read the 'יתרה פתוחה' card.
expected: Per the iron rule, a currency with no data shows — or no row at all. Two-row per-currency rendering is correct and works; a zero-valued row for a currency the supplier has never traded in is not.
actual: A '$ 0' line is printed on the screen that owns the supplier's per-currency financial position, contradicting the policy stated in the banner one line below it. (The per-currency separation itself is correct — the two lines are never summed.)

title: The credits table prints the raw translation key 'creditReason_returned' instead of the Hebrew reason
evidence: out/finance/10-credits-all.png (read with the Read tool): the 'סיבה' column of credit #4 reads 'creditReason_returned' in Latin LTR text inside the RTL table. Code: src/pages/Credits.tsx:67 `render: (r) => CREDIT_REASON[r.reason]` and :154 `<dd>{CREDIT_REASON[credit.reason]}</dd>` — CREDIT_REASON (src/lib/status.ts:217-224) maps to translation KEYS, and neither call site passes the result through t(). The strings exist: he.ts:373 'החזרת סחורה', en.ts:369 'Goods returned'.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /credits?status=all → read the 'סיבה' column; also open the credit's detail panel.
expected: 'החזרת סחורה' (Hebrew) / 'Goods returned' (English), like every other status label on the screen.
actual: The raw key is rendered, in both the list column and the detail panel, in both languages. Affects all six reason values, not just this row.

title: The duplicate-suspect filter returns zero invoices while the invoice card and the exceptions queue both flag the same invoice as a duplicate
evidence: out/finance/text-inv-duplicates.txt: '/invoices?attention=duplicates' → '0 חשבוניות · 1 מסננים פעילים / אין תוצאות לסינון הנוכחי'. out/finance/text-inv-7702.txt: the detail page for invoice 7702 shows 'נמצאה חשבונית נוספת של אותו ספק עם אותו מספר — יש לתקן את הכפילות לפני אישור'. out/finance/text-exceptions.txt line 41: OPEN, severity גבוהה, 'חשד לחשבונית כפולה — חשד לחשבונית כפולה — בשר והבן #7702'. out/finance/text-inv-q7702.txt: searching 7702 as the accountant returns 1 row, so the alleged duplicate is not reachable from this role.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /invoices?attention=duplicates (0 rows) → /invoices?q=7702 → open the row → read the warning under the reconciliation block → /exceptions and read the 'חשד לחשבונית כפולה' row.
expected: The filter built to surface duplicate-suspect invoices lists the invoice the product itself flags. The warning names an action the reader can take.
actual: The filter says there are none; two other surfaces say invoice 7702 is a duplicate. The warning also names the wrong action — it says to fix the duplicate 'לפני אישור' while the invoice is already מאושרת and שולמה, and the accountant cannot see or reach the other copy.

title: The same KPI label, 'יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות', reports 790 ILS to the accountant and 11,582 ILS to the owner, with nothing saying the accountant's figure is scoped
evidence: out/finance/10-acct-dashboard.png: accountant KPI 'יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות ‏790 ‏₪', donut 'יתרות פתוחות לפי ספק' 790 total (תבליני הגליל 640 + אריזות הדרום 150). out/finance/text-inv-open.txt: /invoices?pay=open → '2 חשבוניות', 150 + 640 = 790. Coordinator's measurement of the owner dashboard at 2026-09-04 00:23: 11,582 ILS across 8 open invoices. Cause (code): supabase/migrations/0218 p0_invoice_balance_rows_by_currency restricts the accountant arm to `i.review_status = 'approved'`; all 10 invoices the accountant can see are מאושרת.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /dashboard → read 'יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות' → /invoices?pay=open and total the balance column. Compare with the owner dashboard tile of the same name.
expected: Either the two roles see the same total, or the accountant's screen states that the figure covers approved invoices only. §12 requires one trustworthy picture.
actual: The accountant — the person who reconciles against a bank statement — is shown 790 ILS of open payables where the business has 11,582 ILS, under an identical label with no qualifier. The accountant's own screens are internally consistent at 790; the disagreement is purely cross-role. I measured only the accountant side; the owner figure is the coordinator's.

title: The bank un-match dialog marks its reason box required with '*' but never enforces it and substitutes a placeholder into the audit log
evidence: out/finance/text-bank-matched-2950.txt: the dialog label is 'סיבה להסרת ההתאמה *'. out/finance/unmatch-wire.json: pressing 'הסרת התאמה' with the box EMPTY fired POST rpc/unmatch_bank_transaction (the client did not block). Code: src/pages/Bank.tsx:264 `p_reason: reasonOr(reason, 'הסרת ההתאמה')`, and src/lib/reason.ts:22-26 returns '<action> — ללא הערה מהמשתמש' when the box is empty. The match dialog on the SAME screen uses the project's own optional label, 'סיבת הפעולה (רשות)' (out/finance/text-bank-unmatched-open.txt).
repro: Sign in as accountant → /bank → click a 'מותאמת' row → leave 'סיבה להסרת ההתאמה *' empty → press 'הסרת התאמה' → watch the network tab.
expected: Either the asterisk is honoured (button blocked until a reason is typed) or the label matches the product's own decision that the box is optional — the same label the match dialog beside it uses.
actual: The asterisk is decorative; the audit line records the tautology 'הסרת ההתאמה — ללא הערה מהמשתמש'. Two contradictory conventions for the same optional field on one screen. Server-side reason enforcement is UNVERIFIED — this request was refused first for an unrelated reason (see the note on the direct-match refusal).

title: The balance column renders a measured zero as '—', so 'paid in full' and 'balance unknown' are indistinguishable
evidence: out/finance/00-invoices.png (read with the Read tool): the 'יתרה' column shows '—' for 9 of 10 rows, including 7702. out/finance/text-inv-7702.txt: the detail page for the same invoice shows 'יתרה לתשלום ‏0.00 ‏₪'. Code: src/pages/Invoices.tsx `r.balance != null && r.balance > 0 ? fmtMoneyExact(...) : —` — a null balance and a 0 balance render identically.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /invoices → read the 'יתרה' column → open any 'שולמה' row and read 'יתרה לתשלום'.
expected: The project rule is that no data shows '—' and never '0'. The mirror also has to hold: a measured 0.00 is data and should not borrow the no-data marker, or the list and the detail must at least agree.
actual: The list says '—' where the detail says '0.00 ₪' for the same invoice, and an invoice whose balance failed to load would look identical to one that is fully paid.

title: The execution dialog says the transfer cannot be performed and offers an enabled 'ההעברה בוצעה' button two blocks below
evidence: out/finance/60-pay-card-open.png + text-pay-card-open.txt: red block 'לא הוזנו פרטי בנק לספק זה, ולכן לא ניתן לבצע את ההעברה...' immediately followed by 'הכפתור בתחתית המסך מתעד העברה שכבר בוצעה בבנק — הוא אינו מבצע אותה'. out/finance/pay-submit-after-ref.json: the 'ההעברה בוצעה' button measures `disabled: false` both with the mandatory 'אסמכתת העברה *' empty and after filling it. Both of the 2 pending items are in this state.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /pay → open either pending card → read the red block, then look at the footer button.
expected: One statement about whether the action is possible. If the button only records a transfer already made at the bank, the red block should not say the action cannot be performed.
actual: Two adjacent sentences say opposite things on a money screen, and the queue's stated job ('ביצוע ההעברות שאושרו') is impossible for 2 of 2 items because no supplier bank details are stored. The reference field IS validated on click (src/pages/AccountantPaymentQueue.tsx:428) — the enabled button alone is not the defect.
